name: Mattbusel/llm-template
summary: 据发布者介绍，llm-template 是一个 C++17 单头文件库，可注册具名提示词模板，使用 Mustache 风格的变量、循环和条件进行渲染，并通过截短最长的变量值来满足 token 预算。

The publisher describes llm-template as a single-header C++17 library for registering named prompt templates and rendering them with Mustache-style variables, loops, and conditionals. It can trim the longest variable to fit a token budget.
